The 'none' branch stores 1, 'power' stores max(cost, minimumCost)^-beta and 'gaussian' stores the truncated, rescaled (exp(-0.5 (c/L)^2) - exp(-0.5)) / (1 - exp(-0.5)); they are alternative branches of the same kernel.
